newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-BRAVES CATCHER LOPEZ AGREES TO ONE-YEAR DEAL.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-BRAVES CATCHER LOPEZ AGREES TO ONE-YEAR DEAL.

text.p: The Atlanta Braves on Friday agreed to terms on a one-year contract with catcher Javy Lopez, the final player on the team still eligible for arbitration.
Financial terms were not dislosed, but Lopez had been asking for $2.6 million in arbitration, while the Braves had offered $1.4 million.
The 26-year-old Lopez was named Most Valuable Player of the 1996 National League Championship Series, batting .542 (13-for-24) with two homers and six RBI to help the Braves reach the World Series.
Lopez hit .282 with 23 homers and 69 RBI last season and caught a club-record 135 games in the regular season.
